verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment products, since self-hostable payment servers and orchestrators exist, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe's core product can be self-hosted. Every capability documented, including Checkout, Billing, the remote MCP server at mcp.stripe.com and sandboxes, runs on Stripe's own hosted infrastructure. Client-side SDKs, the CLI and OpenAPI files are developer building blocks, not a self-hostable core, so they earn no credit.
